about: The licences of the GESLA-fit constant sets (L-NC). contributor_roles.csv names one licence_id per GESLA contributor; otc_pipeline.gesla_licences maps each record to it (data/gesla/licence_overrides.csv overrides single records) and refuses a contributor or licence id it does not know. `licences` rows are format 1.0 `licence` objects, validated against the pinned schema. `sources` records, per licence, what sets it and when it was checked.

sources.gesla-bodc-nc: Originator-terms check 2026-10-10 (cr/otc-impl/L-NC/originator-terms.md), quotes verbatim from the URL. RESTRICTED. BODC data licence (https://www.bodc.ac.uk/data/documents/nodb/267795/): 'The use or reproduction of data for commercial purposes might require additional permission from the data source and may incur a charge. ... Users should not give any data or products to third parties without prior consent from BODC.' NOC = BODC everywhere (orchestrator decision, round 8): every record whose GESLA ORIGINATOR or UHSLC Data_Source names BODC, the National Oceanography Centre or the Proudman Oceanographic Laboratory is withheld under this switch, on any channel (NOC, CMEMS, UHSLC). Records with no stated originator (UHSLC fast delivery 'Unspecified', DA_IDH 'Ivan D. Haigh') at a BODC gauge (same STMAP station, a shared registry id, or within 100 m) are withheld too: Plymouth (Devonport) and Port Erin CMEMS copies share registry ids with the BODC records (UK National Tide Gauge Network, https://ntslf.org/tides/uk-network; BODC: 'BODC has a special responsibility for the remote monitoring and retrieval of sea level data from the network'). NOC lineage (orchestrator decision, round 9): the NERC Vocabulary Server's BODC organisation history for POL (https://vocab.nerc.ac.uk/collection/C75/current/POL/3/) lists 'Institute of Oceanographic Sciences Bidston Laboratory(1973-01-01 to 1989-03-31)', 'Proudman Oceanographic Laboratory(1989-04-01 to 2010-03-31)' and 'National Oceanography Centre, Liverpool(2010-04-01 to 2017-06-14)'; BODC's history (https://bodc.ac.uk/about/what_is_bodc/our_history): 'NOC was formed on 01 April 2010 from the Proudman Oceanographic Laboratory and the National Oceanography Centre, Southampton (NOCS).' So IOS Bidston, POL and NOC records are withheld here: Port Louis 103A and 103B and Port Victoria 111A (UHSLC Data_Source 'Institute of Oceanographic Sciences (IOS) Bidston Observatory').
sources.gesla-bom-nc: Originator-terms check 2026-10-10 (cr/otc-impl/L-NC/originator-terms.md), quotes verbatim from the URL. RESTRICTED. The ABSLMP data page (https://www.bom.gov.au/oceanography/projects/abslmp/data/index.shtml) states no licence. The BOM copyright page: 'If there are no stated terms of use: Unless we state otherwise, you can download, copy and use our content for personal use, or use within your organisation. You must not supply it to any other person or use it for any commercial purpose.' An AIMS-hosted ABSLMP metadata copy carries CC BY-NC 3.0 AU. Withheld (orchestrator rule, round 5): 'You must not supply it to any other person'. Also withheld by originator: the 56 UHSLC_RQ records whose GESLA ORIGINATOR names the National Tidal Centre, Bureau of Meteorology (54 name it alone; 2 name it for the present period after CSIRO), and their UHSLC fast-delivery twins (licence_overrides.csv).

sources.gesla-chs-withheld: Basis (orchestrator round 8, final-confirm-C W-CHS): DFO terms (https://www.dfo-mpo.gc.ca/terms-avis/terms-conditions-avis-eng.htm), the page the MEDS archive links to: 'If you wish to reproduce Canadian Hydrographic Service navigational charts, publications, data or other hydrographic products, please contact CHS directly'. MEDS records are CHS data: the MEDS archive page (https://meds-sdmm.dfo-mpo.gc.ca/isdm-gdsi/twl-mne/index-eng.htm): 'Observations from the CHS Permanent Water Level Network are added on a daily to monthly basis. Data are also exchanged annually with the Water Survey of Canada.' The CHS licence agreement (https://www.tides.gc.ca/en/licence-agreement) covers 'the CHS Data delivered via CHS' website': it keeps CHS's copyright ('The copyrights of CHS in the Data remain the property of CHS and shall not be sold, licensed, leased, assigned or given to a third party'), excludes derivative products for commercial purposes, and allows not-for-profit derivative products with a set notice ('This product is not to be used for navigation ... contains intellectual property (Data) of the Canadian Hydrographic Service'): if CHS records are ever published, that notice is required. CHS copyright page (https://www.charts.gc.ca/copyright-droitdauteur/index-eng.html): tide data 'free for non-navigational and non-commercial use', '$25 per station for constituent sets'. The Open Government Licence record (https://open.canada.ca/data/en/dataset/87b08750-4180-4d31-9414-a9470eba9b42) attaches OGL-Canada 2.0 to the station inventory, not to the observation archive (round-3 OGL claim withdrawn). Also withheld by originator: UHSLC records whose GESLA ORIGINATOR or UHSLC Data_Source is the Marine Environmental Data Service, DFO (licence_overrides.csv).
sources.gesla-cmems-nc: GESLA licence page, checked 2026-10-10: CMEMS 'Research (for consultancy contact data owners directly)'. Owner decision 2026-10-08: keep, mark non-commercial (CC BY-NC 4.0). The CMEMS licence (https://marine.copernicus.eu/user-corner/service-commitments-and-licence) asks for the credit 'Generated using E.U. Copernicus Marine Service Information; insert DOIs links here'. Product and DOI: the GESLA-4.1 metadata gives every CMEMS record a product_id INSITU_GLO_NRT_OBSERVATIONS_013_<n> with n counting up from 030 row by row (717 different values), which we read as a spreadsheet fill of INSITU_GLO_NRT_OBSERVATIONS_013_030 (our reading, not stated by GESLA). That product's archive record (https://sextant.ifremer.fr/geonetwork/srv/api/records/d1cc8137-d8ca-4aa2-b87d-79ef2607ece1) cites DOI 10.48670/moi-00036, which resolves to its successor INSITU_GLO_PHYBGCWAV_DISCRETE_MYNRT_013_030 (checked 2026-10-10).

ISPRA Note legali (https://www.isprambiente.gov.it/it/note-legali): 'Salvo ove diversamente indicato, i dati pubblicati sul presente sito sono messi a disposizione con licenza CC-BY 4.0 ... liberamente accessibili, distribuibili e riutilizzabili, a patto che sia sempre citata la fonte'. sources.gesla-jodc-nc: JODC_JMA, JODC_PAHB, JODC_JCG and JODC_GIAJ all come through J-DOSS (GESLA contributor 'Japan Oceanographic Data Center', website https://jdoss1.jodc.go.jp/vpage/tide.html). J-DOSS (https://www.jodc.go.jp/jodcweb/JDOSS/index.html): 'Not to reproduce the data and provide it to the third party without permission'; footer 'No reproduction or republication without written permission.' J-DOSS also addresses products: 'To include a description regarding the data source or acknowledge it in your articles, publications or other products in which the data downloaded from JODC site was used, and please send a copy of the publication or product to JODC.' With the footer's ban on republication, withholding stays the conservative reading (orchestrator rule, round 5). JMA's own Public Data License covers JMA website content, not the JODC copy. The ORIGINATOR decides (orchestrator decisions, rounds 7-8): JODC-family records are withheld on the JODC channel, and so are UHSLC records whose GESLA ORIGINATOR or UHSLC Data_Source names the Japan Oceanographic Data Center (including Wakkanai 360A: 'and for data prior to 2011 Japan Oceanographic Data Center') and their fast-delivery copies whose span the JODC version covers (licence_overrides.csv). JMA-originated records outside the JODC portal are not withheld (gesla-uhslc-jma-nc); a JODC_JMA record is withheld on its channel and does not withhold other copies of its gauge.

Anyone downloading the information is to contact SANHO to request permission to use or reproduce the data.' sources.gesla-uhslc-jma-nc: UHSLC records whose originator is the Japan Meteorological Agency (GESLA ORIGINATOR, and UHSLC metadata Data_Source 'Japan Meteorological Agency'), and their fast-delivery twins (licence_overrides.csv). Orchestrator decisions, rounds 7-8: the ORIGINATOR decides; JMA's terms (https://www.jma.go.jp/jma/en/copyright.html): information on the JMA website 'may be used in accordance with the terms and conditions of use stipulated in Public Data License (Version 1.0)', with the source cited and, for edited content, a statement that it was edited; PDL 1.0 (https://www.digital.go.jp/en/resources/open_data/public_data_license_v1.0): 'Commercial use of "This Content" is also permitted.' The UHSLC metadata of these stations says the data were downloaded from the JMA website (Legal Notice http://www.jma.go.jp/jma/en/copyright.html). Non-commercial only because UHSLC's own terms are unclear. Wakkanai 360A is not here: its UHSLC Data_Source adds 'for data prior to 2011 Japan Oceanographic Data Center', so it is withheld under gesla-jodc-nc (a 2011+ refit is on the backlog).
sources.gesla-uhslc-nc: Originator-terms check 2026-10-10 (cr/otc-impl/L-NC/originator-terms.md), quotes verbatim from the URL. UNCLEAR. JASL/NCEI record (https://www.ncei.noaa.gov/access/metadata/landing-page/bin/iso?id=gov.noaa.nodc:0019568): 'Some of the data in this dataset is licensed under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0) License' (some, not all). UHSLC pages carry 'All Rights Reserved' and no data licence; national originators (about 45 countries) not checked one by one. Non-commercial until confirmed (orchestrator decision 2026-10-10). Malakal 007 and Saipan 028 fast delivery are UHSLC-operated series (they start with 007B/028B, UHSLC Data_Source 'UH Sea Level Center'), not the 1926-1940 JODC versions, so they stay here.
sources.gesla-uhslc-ntf-nc: UHSLC records whose station metadata names the National Tidal Facility (Flinders University of South Australia) as a source, and that no withheld switch takes (licence_overrides.csv; orchestrator decision, round 9: NTF is not BOM, so they stay published). The UHSLC metadata (for example https://uhslc.soest.hawaii.edu/rqds/metadata_yaml/063Ameta.yaml) carries NTF's conditions: 'When any data supplied by the National Tidal Facility is used in any publication or report, the origin of such data shall be acknowledged in that publication or report in the following approved form ... by the National Tidal Facility, The Flinders University of South Australia, Copyright reserved.' sources.gesla-unam-nc: UNAM (50 fit-4 records) and UNAM_HIST (35): GESLA metadata names the Servicio Mareografico Nacional (SMN), Instituto de Geofisica, UNAM, for both. The GESLA page lists UNAM as 'Research and consultancy' and does not list UNAM_HIST. The SMN site footer (https://www.mareografico.unam.mx/index.php/informacion/, checked 2026-10-10) reads: 'Todos los derechos reservados (2022). Esta pagina y sus contenidos pueden ser reproducidos con fines no lucrativos, siempre y cuando no se mutile, se cite la fuente completa y su direccion electronica, de otra forma, se requiere permiso previo por escrito de la Institucion.' The owner's own term (non-profit reuse only) sets the licence: non-commercial (review C1). The footer covers 'this page and its contents'; its scope over data sent on request is not explicit (LIC-TERMS). The SMN data request form (https://www.mareografico.unam.mx/wp-content/uploads/2022/09/formato_solicitud_datos.pdf) asks for the intended use and a citation.

unlisted_open._why: GESLA 'unlisted' contributors whose own publisher documents an open licence: TTW (LINZ, CC BY 3.0 NZ) and RWS_HIST (Rijkswaterstaat, CC0); see sources. Only these contributor -> licence pairs may give an unlisted record a commercial licence. The owner decision of 2026-10-08 also has UNAM_HIST follow its publisher, whose terms are non-commercial (gesla-unam-nc), so it is not listed here.

withheld._why: One switch per licence: the records under a licence listed here are left out of the release until the data owner grants permission. Rule (orchestrator, round 5): an originator whose own terms forbid supplying, reproducing or giving the data (or products) to third parties without permission is withheld, by ORIGINATOR, not by channel: copies of its records redistributed by CMEMS, UHSLC or another channel carry the same licence (licence_overrides.csv). JMA is not withheld outside the JODC portal: its own terms are the Public Data License 1.0 (round 7). The build refuses each record with the reason and reports any station left with no published set. To lift one, delete its entry. Each switch lists the originator_patterns of its agency: the build stops if a record whose GESLA ORIGINATOR or UHSLC Data_Source (data/gesla/record_originators.csv) matches one does not get a withheld licence. JMA alone is never matched: JMA-originated records outside the JODC portal are published (gesla-uhslc-jma-nc).

originators._why: A per-record override may move a record to a commercial licence only when the record's own originator field (record_originators.csv: GESLA ORIGINATOR or UHSLC Data_Source) names one of these documented originators of that licence, and its reason quotes the GESLA ORIGINATOR.
gesla-refmar: Réseaux de référence des observations marégraphiques

originator_licences._why: A record of these contributors whose originator (record_originators.csv) matches, and that no withheld switch takes, must carry this licence, or the build stops: the JMA-originated UHSLC records need the JMA PDL 1.0 attribution.
